question: Who among the following has received the USA's prestigious National Book Award for Fiction 2020 for his satirical cinematic novel 'Interior Chinatown'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Charles YU____.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Charles Yu won the** National Book Award for fiction for his mind-bending satire, “Interior Chinatown**,” a sendup of Hollywood and Asian-American stereotypes.
 
• **Tamara Payne **worked as a principal researcher her bestselling books include "**The Dead are Arising**".
 
• **Walter Ellis Mosley** is an American novelist most widely recognized for his crime fiction.
 
• **Morgan Giles **was a Royal Navy officer during the Second World War, who later served as a Conservative Member of Parliament of the UK.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Book Awards were established in **1936 by the American Booksellers Association abandoned during World War II,** and re-established by three book industry organizations in **1950.**
 
• **Non-U.S. authors **and publishers were eligible for the pre-war awards. Now they are presented to U.S. authors for books published in the United States roughly during the award year.
